title: The Vatican's sun cross and pine cone
summary: Matt tells of The Vatican's sun cross and pine cone, about present day at Vatican, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the pope and the Vatican have that very same cross not only that the pope has it on its his um on its cloak and in front of the Vatican is a giant pine cone

plain: A researcher called Matt, speaking on host Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, points to symbols at the Vatican, the home of the Catholic Church. He says the Pope wears the very same sun cross on his cloak that appears in older traditions, and that a giant pine cone stands in front of the Vatican, suggesting the Church carries on much older symbols.
